topography.project_purpose: Dexs. Structurally: 55 project-authored contract(s) across 1 chain(s); 1 ERC4626 vault, 3 ERC20 tokens, 1 ERC721 NFT; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 10 functional families. Its contracts share 8 common project-authored base contract(s) (peripheryvalidation, blocktimestamp, peripherypaymentswithfee). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
